title: China has revised regulations to tighten protection of chip layout designs, including punitive damages for serious infringement, taking effect on October 15 (Eduardo Baptista/Reuters)
summary: Eduardo Baptista / Reuters: China has revised regulations to tighten protection of chip layout designs, including punitive damages for serious infringement, taking effect on October 15 — China has revised regulations protecting integrated-circuit layout designs, tightening registration standards and allowing punitive damages …
